_comment: Underwriting thresholds for UK property comparison. Signals scored 0/1 per property; higher score = stronger investment case.

_notes.min_gross_yield_pct: 5% gross is the floor for BTL outside Zone 1-2 London. Drop to 3.5% for capital-growth buyers.
_notes.max_price_premium_pct: Asking prices above comp median by more than this trigger a fail signal.
_notes.min_epc_rating: E is the MEES minimum for rental. F/G = unlettable without exemption.
_notes.max_annual_service_charge: Above £5k/year materially erodes net yield on typical flats.
_notes.min_lease_remaining_years: Below 90 years affects mortgage-ability and resale. Below 80 is a hard problem.
_notes.min_comp_count: Fewer than 3 comps = thin market; flag but do not auto-fail.
_notes.min_rental_listing_count: Below 5 live rentals = thin market; flag yield confidence as low.
_notes.net_yield_cost_allowance_pct: 30% covers voids, management, maintenance, insurance. Drop to 20% for self-managed.
_notes.ranking_tiebreak_priority: In a score tie, rank by these fields in order.
